name: Blue willow transferware
summary: White earthenware that carries a blue pattern in the Chinese manner, printed from an engraved copper plate. The willow pattern, with a bridge, a tree, a boat and two birds, is the best known of the many designs.

philosophy.core_thesis: A copper plate puts a Chinese-style blue picture on cheap white earthenware, so that every household owns the pattern that once only a rich house could buy.
design_principles: Engrave the pattern on a copper plate in fine lines, and print it with cobalt ink on thin tissue.
Rub the wet tissue on the biscuit ware, so that the blue lines pass to the surface.
Fix the print in a low firing, then dip the piece in clear glaze, and fire it again.
Arrange the picture in a ring: a border, a main scene, and a small repeat on the rim.
Draw the willow scene with a bridge, a tree, a pagoda, a boat, a fence and two birds in the sky.
Use one tone of blue that is deep and even, and a clear glaze that stays white.
Put the pattern name and the maker mark in the base, so that a customer can order again.
anti_patterns: A hand-painted line with a free, uneven brush
A moulded relief with no printed pattern

form.shape: Plates, soup plates, meat dishes, tureens, sauceboats and bowls, in a plain classical outline.
form.profile: A round plate with a flat rim and a shallow well; the printed pattern covers the whole face.
form.foot_and_rim: A low plain foot with a glazed base, and a rim with a moulded edge or a plain edge; the pattern name is in the base.
form.proportion: Plate diameter 20 to 26 cm and wall 4 to 5 mm thick; the border is about one quarter of the width.
rules: Divide the face into a border on the rim and a scene in the well.
Cover the face with print, so that no white shows for more than 2 cm.
Repeat the same pattern on every piece in the service.

bodies.rule: Use a white earthenware with a clear glaze. Pearlware has a trace of cobalt, so that it looks white against the blue.

methods: press moulding of tureens and dishes
forming.joins: Handles and knops are moulded and luted with slip; the plate rim carries a moulded edge.
forming.details: A small seam in the print where two sheets of tissue meet, a trace of blue in the glaze pool at the foot, and the pattern name in the base.

glaze.pattern: The willow scene: a bridge with three figures, a willow tree, a pagoda, a boat, an island and two birds, with a border of fence, trellis and flowers.
glaze.gloss: Bright gloss, about 80 to 90 GU, on a white to blue-white ground.
glaze.wear: The blue stays under the glaze; the glaze crazes in a fine net, and the cutlery marks the well.

palette.strategy: One deep cobalt blue on a bright white ground; the blue is the only colour.

firing.kiln: A coal-fired bottle kiln; the ware goes in saggars for the biscuit, the print and the glaze.
processes: printing from a copper plate on tissue
firing the print at a low heat
firing.scale: Dozens of Staffordshire factories printed the pattern, in millions of pieces a year, for the home and for export.
firing.signs: A seam in the print, a pattern name and a maker mark in the base, and a blue tone that is even from piece to piece.

pieces.form: Plate with the willow scene in the well and a trellis border on the rim
Large meat dish with a willow scene and a plain wall
Covered tureen with the willow scene on the body and a flower knop
Deep plate with a printed border and a moulded edge
Boat with a loop handle and a pattern in a narrow band

positive: bridge, willow tree, pagoda and two birds

evidence.title: Blue and white plate with Willow pattern

emotion.target_response: A warm, homely nostalgia: the viewer sees the old story in blue on a white plate and thinks of a family table.

use_cases: a blue pattern brief for a plate
a museum label on printed earthenware
avoid_when: the brief needs a hand-painted free brush
the brief wants porcelain with gold
the brief wants a plain minimal form

modifiers.how: Change the body to buff earthenware with a thick tin glaze, and paint the blue by hand with a free brush.
Change the body to bone china and add a gilt rim and a painted flower band.
Drop the print and glaze the whole piece in one strong colour.
